extracted.name: Corn pudding
ingredient_lines: 1 can creamed corn (14-15 ounce size can)
1 can regular corn (drained 14-15 ounce size can)
1 stick (1/2 cup) butter melted and cooled
instruction_lines: Grease and flour a large baking pan. (I use a disposable roaster pan)
In a large bowl mix all the listed ingredients.
Pour batter into greased and floured pan and bake for 45 minutes until a knife inserted comes out clean. I let it rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
